Doesn't restore many hearts, but it can lower your body temperature.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Icy Prime Meats are a type of [[Frozen Food]], which is made by freezing [[Raw Prime Meat]]s in a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} When eaten, Icy Prime Meats heal one and a half of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and grants one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Icy Prime Meats return as a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They are made by exposing [[Raw Prime Meat]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. If [[Link]] eats an Icy Prime Meat, one and a half of his [[Heart]]s will be restored, and he will be granted one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Icy Gourmet Meat * Icy Meat * Raw Prime Meat * Seared Prime Steak }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats |items= BotW, TotK }}
